title: 案山子 (Kakashi — Scarecrow)
description: A gently humorous 1911 song about a one-legged scarecrow standing in a rice field from morning to night, rain gear and all, unable to walk or hear. Even when the mountain crows mock it with their 'caw caw' laugh, the scarecrow never moves — because it has no ears. A charming portrait of this farm guardian and its absurd predicament.
